title: 30A East Bella Vista Inlet Beach, FL Stay at 30A Vacation Rentals

description_expanded: OverviewTop Reasons to Book this Fabulous Lakeside Retreat!* Directly on Camp Creek Lake – Enjoy peaceful lakefront views and a tranquil 30A setting* Private Dock – Fish, relax, or launch a kayak, paddle board, or pedal boat right from the property* Pet Friendly (add'l $200 fee applies)* 4 Complimentary Bikes* Beach Chairs, Umbrellas and Toys Included* Paddle to the Beach – Enjoy an approximately 10–15 minute paddle from the lake to a quiet beach acces-2 Kayaks, Paddle Board and Pedal Boat Included for you!* ½ Mile to Gulf Lakes Public Beach Access – Easily walk or bike to the beautiful Gulf shoreline* 3 Minutes to The Big Chill * Can Be Rented with Coastal Chateau – Combine both units for larger groups, subject to availability* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. *Please Note: Bella Vista is the lower floor of a two-level cottage and is one of two individual rental units. Your reservation is for Bella Vista only unless otherwise specified. The second unit may be occupied by other guests during your stay. The dock is shared when the units are rented separately. Bella Vista may be rented together with Coastal Chateau, subject to availability. Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door.Welcome to Bella Vista, a peaceful lakeside escape located directly on the tranquil waters of Camp Creek Lake in Seacrest. This charming retreat is designed for guests who want to slow down, reconnect, and experience a quieter side of 30A. Enjoy peaceful lake views from the deck, gather around the fire pit under the stars, fishing from the dock, paddling across the lake, biking along 30A, then rinse off after a beach adventure in the outdoor shower. Inside, Bella Vista offers two bedrooms and one bathroom. This home comfortably sleeps up to 4 guests. The bright and inviting living space provides a comfortable place to gather, while the large windows and balcony allow the peaceful lake setting to become part of the experience. The master Bedroom features a Queen bed, while the second bedroom offers two Twin beds. Bella Vista offers the perfect opportunity to slow down and enjoy the simple moments of a 30A vacation. Bella Vista is ideal for a couple, small family, or friends traveling together. The Bed Setup:Master Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: 2 Twin BedsArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!Show less
